request.style: English, driving anthemic rock, strong gritty male vocal, overdriven electric guitars, bass, pounding live drums, big gang vocals on the chorus, defiant and confident, 128 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the wicked close around me and they come to tear me down
They are the ones who stumble and they crash onto the ground
Let an army camp against me, let the war break out tonight
Even then I will be confident, the LORD is my light

[Chorus]
The LORD is my light and my salvation
Whom shall I fear?
The LORD is the stronghold of my life
Of whom shall I be afraid?

[Verse]
One thing I ask of the LORD, this is what I seek
To dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life
To gaze on the beauty of the LORD
And to seek him in his temple

[Chorus]
The LORD is my light and my salvation
Whom shall I fear?
The LORD is the stronghold of my life
Of whom shall I be afraid?

[Bridge]
In the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his shelter
He will hide me under the cover of his tent
And set me high upon a rock

[Chorus]
The LORD is my light and my salvation
Whom shall I fear?
The LORD is the stronghold of my life
Of whom shall I be afraid?

[Outro]
Wait for the LORD
Be strong, and let your heart take courage
Wait for the LORD
